detail.text: The structural step is proved (PR #760, holes h_prime and h_comp, witnesses True). Both remaining cases are realised by known exceptions to the ELS problem with n < k^2, e.g. (44,8) = 4*11 and (46,10) = 2*23 for h_comp, so neither hole is vacuous. Kummer at a prime p | g does not close h_comp: v_p(n) = v_p(g) <= v_p(k), so the lowest nonzero base-p digit of n is never below k's and the last-digit borrow never fires; a borrow must come from a higher digit, which is the residue (Ecklund/ELS) prob…

route.text: m = n/gcd(n,k) has minFac > k and m < k^2, so m is a prime q > k; split n prime (gcd=1) from n = g*q with 2 <= g | k (partial PR #760)
